author: W1, independent preparation author
before: site-packages is empty and the .venv has no pip (PHASE.json starting_state)

labels.<prefix>: the Homebrew prefix that pyvenv.cfg's home names

pip_written_in_each_dist_info.RECORD: rewritten by pip for the installed files; its bytes are not predicted here

rules: Apart from the new content of site-packages and bin_additions, the .venv's entries stay exactly observed_before: nothing else is added, removed or changed (pyvenv.cfg and the launcher links included).
site-packages holds exactly the entries of site_packages_top_level, and nothing else.
Its .dist-info directories are exactly dist_info_directories, with no .egg-info: no other distribution may appear, pip included (no pip, setuptools, wheel or _distutils_hack, and no .pth file).
No __pycache__ directory and no .pyc file appears anywhere in the .venv; the framework part of the observer's python_inventory is unchanged by the step (PREPARATION-PLAN.md section 3; W3's F4).

Each distribution's installed files are exactly its files, with the wheel's bytes, plus pip's INSTALLER and REQUESTED and the rewritten RECORD in its .dist-info; every site-packages file is owned by one of the seven RECORD files (A6).
bin_additions are the console scripts that pip generates in the .venv's bin directory from the wheels' entry points; they lie outside site-packages and are owned by their RECORD.
Hash enforcement stays on (--require-hashes, from the committed lock), and the install is offline (--no-index, --find-links to the verified downloads), as the procedure states.
